newsitems.title: JULY 2026 Development Update
newsitems.author: nathan.tran
newsitems.contents: And can you tell me, doctor, why I still can't get to sleep? And night time's just a jungle dark and a barking M16? And what's this rash that comes and goes? Can you tell me what it means? God help me I was only nineteen- Redgum 30,000 WishlistsOut-fucking-standing.Thank you. Sincerely.I will not take your attention for granted. Each wishlist feels like a personal promise from me to you to deliver an unforgettable game. ProgressA short update this month, everyone. There’s a lot happening behind the scenes right now, though much of it isn’t the sexy, exciting stuff that makes for great updates.A few key highlights:We’re preparing to begin conversations with interested publishers.We recently met with our production director advisor, who has helped us refine our production plan.A number of other advisors are continuing to provide guidance and feedback.We’re in ongoing discussions with potential co-development partners who could bring significant additional talent and resources to the project.External agencies are reviewing our prototype to help us better understand where we stand and where we can improve.We’re experimenting with some technology that may (no promises!) be used in the game (see thumbnail).If you haven’t already, please consider wishlisting the game. Even still, it genuinely makes a difference.And if you want to follow the journey more closely, join our Discord to stay connected. — Nathan TranNon-Euclidean

newsitems.title: JUNE 2026 Development Update
newsitems.author: nathan.tran
newsitems.contents: Cinema, simulated life, ill drama Fourth Reich culture, Americana Chained to the dream they got ya searchin' for The thin line between entertainment and war- Rage Against The MachineHello My name is Nathan Tran. I'm the creative director of War Fantasy, and for nearly a decade this project has been my dream. I started this project as a programming student in 2017 when I made the concept demo pictured above. Since then, I have fought to keep the project alive however possible.To be clear: the trailer you have likely seen was not the product of a studio with resources, but instead a call to arms made by a handful of developers without proper funding.Where Things StandThroughout development, I will be as transparent with you as possible. Currently, War Fantasy is in a partially playable state with years of work existing half in-engine and half on a drawing board. The main blocker, for all of those years, has been funding.Simply put: people with money won't take a bet on a project like this unless the numbers force them to. They need to see the metrics. Without your wishlists and shares, this game doesn't get greenlit. On Timelines and PatienceCurrently I'm assembling the team and revising the budget and development plan. Doors that were closed are starting to open because of your attention on this project. Thanks to you we now have a fighting chance. But I want to be honest: this is still going to take time.I intend to give War Fantasy the time it needs, not just to be a good game, but to be a great one. My goal is not quick shock value or a flash-in-the-pan, and I have no intention of rushing it to capitalize on current world events or market trends. My goal is to make something that endures for decades through complete commitment & dedication to its subject matter.So I'm asking for your patience. This project has been a fight every single day for nine years. It will continue to be, but I refuse to stop. Monthly UpdatesThis is the first of monthly development updates. Not every update will bring major announcements, but they will be consistent with honest progress, however incremental. For more frequent updates I invite you to join our discord server. Please wishlist if you haven't already. This is a long road, and it gets steeper up ahead. Thank you for being here. — Nathan TranNon-Euclidean
